title: Line hit
description: Which logical line a visual row belongs to, or null when the row is past the last line. Null is the correct answer for a click below a short transcript: it must select nothing rather than snapping to the final character.

line.description: Index of the line, absolute rather than relative to the window.

offset.description: Character offset at which this visual row starts within the line. A caller adds its own column to reach the character.
